whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sarfaraz Hotel,

I noticed your hotel has strong 4.4★ reviews near Patna Junction, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct room bookings and food inquiries.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp room booking, menu showcase, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sarfaraz

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sarfaraz Hotel team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Sarfaraz Hotel) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, food/room showcase, and location highlights right near Patna Junction. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact rooms, pricing, aur actual photos setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
